newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica manufacturing production up 0.4 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica manufacturing production up 0.4 pct in '96.

text.p: South African manufacturing production rose 0.4 percent in 1996 compared with 1995, the Central Statistical Service (CSS) said on Thursday.
It calculated the index for the year at 103.4 from 103.0 in 1995.
The service said the total value of sales of manufactured products in 1996 rose 9.1 percent in the same period.
In December, manufacturing production was down 2.4 percent month-on-month on a seasonally adjusted basis and fell 0.4 percent year-on-year.
